subject: english
curriculum: English Curriculum 2020 (Ministry of Education, Pedagogical Secretariat, Language Department) – CEFR-aligned
notes: Grade 3 = Pre-Basic User (Pre-A1), Lexical Pre-Band I (S1 Table 2: 'Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4').
Grades 4–6 = Basic User I (A1). Can-do statements (S3) are one set for grades 4–6; their per-grade placement here is inferred and marked inferred:true.

Grammar Band I (S5) is published per grade (Grade 4/5/6 columns, 'NO DESCRIPTOR' where a structure is not yet taught); grammar items are placed by those columns and are not inferred. The colour-coded level of progression per cell (mostly receptive → mostly correct) is not recoverable from the PDF text.
Lexical Band I Core I = Grade 4 – mid-Grade 5; Core II = mid-Grade 5 – end Grade 6 (S1 Table 2). vocab_sample entries are copied verbatim from S4 and were checked against the parsed list.

The 2020 curriculum organises can-dos as Reception (spoken = Listening, written = Reading), Production (spoken, written), Interaction (spoken, written/online) and Mediation; the strand names here map to those.

3.title_he: הבנת הנשמע: שאלות ומשפטים קצרים עם תמיכה חזותית
3.title_en: Understanding short, slow spoken input with visual support
3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can understand short, very simple questions and statements provided they are delivered slowly and clearly and accompanied by visuals or manual gestures
Can recognize Pre-Band I vocabulary, including instructions, delivered clearly and slowly in a familiar everyday context
Can recognize numbers, prices, dates and days of the week, delivered slowly and clearly
Can understand short, simple instructions for actions such as 'Stop,' 'Close the door'

3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can recognize the letters of the alphabet in upper and lower case
Can recognize the use of a full stop to signal the end of a sentence and a question mark to signal a question
Can recognize the use of upper case to signal the beginning of a sentence and a proper noun
Can read sentences in the correct direction, from left to right and from the top of the page to the bottom

3.title_he: פענוח: צליל-אות, מילים לא סדירות ושטף
3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can accurately read and pronounce phonetically-spelled words and words with familiar orthographic patterns
Can self-correct when decoding a familiar word by choosing the correct phoneme for a grapheme that may be associated with multiple phonemes
Can read familiar 'irregular words'
Can accurately and fluently read familiar words and chunks read aloud

3.title_he: קריאת מילים ומשפטים מאוצר Pre-Band I בעזרת תמונות
3.title_en: Reading Pre-Band I words and sentences with pictures
3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can recognize all the words and phrases in Lexical Pre-Band I especially if accompanied by pictures or illustrations
Can read and understand sentences that contain lexical items from Pre-Band I
Can demonstrate understanding of a word by matching it to a picture
Can recognize a range of basic everyday nouns and adjectives (e.g., colors, numbers, classroom objects) and basic action words (e.g., 'clap', 'stamp', 'jump', 'walk')

3.title_he: לספר על עצמי (שם, גיל, משפחה, הרגשה)
3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can produce short phrases about themselves, giving basic personal information (e.g., name and address)
Can describe him/herself (e.g., name, age, family), using simple words and formulaic expressions, provided he/she can prepare in advance
Can say how he/she is feeling using simple words like 'happy' accompanied by body language

3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can recite and sing using appropriate stress, rhythm and intonation
Can recite a short, simple rhyme or chant
Can sing a basic song from memory with or without the support of gestures and pictures
Can repeat phrases and short sentences, if spoken slowly and clearly

3.title_he: ביטויים שגרתיים: נימוס, בקשות, שאלות קצרות
3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can use a few basic words and phrases to show politeness (e.g., 'please', 'thank you')
Can ask about the identity of an object using a basic phrase (e.g., 'What is it?')
Can ask someone the time; can ask for the spelling of a word, using a basic phrase
Can ask people to do things with them, using a fixed expression (e.g., 'Let's play.')
Can make a few basic requests related to immediate personal needs (e.g., 'Can I go outside?')

3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can ask and answer questions related to personal information using short formulaic expressions and gestures when necessary
Can tell people his/her name and ask other people their name
Can ask and answer questions about him/herself and daily routines, using short, formulaic expressions
Can recognize and produce simple greetings, say his/her name and take leave
Can understand and use some basic responses including 'Yes,' 'No,' 'Please,' 'Sorry'

3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can form letters in accordance with standard print conventions and in relation to marked lines
Can trace and copy individual letters in the correct direction
Can write the letters of the alphabet in upper and lower case
Can write their own name with the correct use of capital letters
Can copy short sentences containing familiar words, if presented in standard printed form
Can signal the end of a sentence using a full stop

3.title_en: Labelling pictures and basic personal information
3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can label simple pictures related to familiar topics by copying single words
Can give basic personal information in writing (e.g., name, address)

3.title_he: אינטראקציה בכתב: משפטים קצרים על עצמי
3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can write short phrases and sentences giving basic personal information

3.title_he: אוצר מילים Pre-Band I, איות וסדר מילים
3.title_en: Pre-Band I vocabulary, spelling and word order
3.band: Pre-A1 / Lexical Pre-Band I (Grade 3 and/or first months of Grade 4)
skills: Can use isolated words and basic expressions to give simple information about him/herself
Can spell words according to the appropriate stage in developmental spelling
Can employ very simple principles of word order in short statements
Can manage very short, isolated, rehearsed utterances using gesture and signaled requests for help when necessary
grammar: No Grammar Band for Pre-A1: only 'very simple principles of word order in short statements'; chunks such as 'I'm …', 'This is a/an …', 'there is / there are', 'Let's …', 'Do you like …?' are learned as formulaic phrases (from Pre-Band I list)
3.source_ref: Pre-Band I list (198 entries); S2 Communicative language competences

4.title_he: הבנת הנשמע: הוראות, שאלות ותיאורים פשוטים
4.title_en: Following teacher talk, instructions and simple descriptions
4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can understand and follow short and simple instructions/directions addressed carefully and slowly to him/her, including simple teacher instructions and explanations
Can understand basic questions about objects present in their immediate surroundings or in pictures (e.g., 'What's this?')
Can understand simple language related to naming and describing people's clothes
Can understand basic information about someone's immediate family with or without the support of pictures or gestures
Can understand basic phrases about the weather, spoken slowly and clearly
4.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

4.title_en: Following short stories and simple dialogues
4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can follow a short, familiar story, with or without the support of pictures, gestures and repetition when delivered slowly and clearly
Can recognize familiar words and basic phrases in short, illustrated stories, read out slowly and clearly
Can identify the day and date in short, simple dialogues, if spoken slowly and clearly and supported by pictures or gestures
4.source_ref: Spoken reception – Listening as a member of a live audience
4.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

4.title_en: Reading short illustrated stories and texts
4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can understand simple stories and shorter texts with the help of pictures and drawings
Can recognize key words and basic phrases in short, simple cartoon stories
Can follow simple dialogues in short, illustrated stories
Can understand basic written instructions for classroom activities (e.g., 'Read and match')
4.source_ref: Written reception – Reading as a leisure activity / instructions
4.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

4.title_en: Describing myself, my family and the weather
4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can describe him/herself, what he/she does and where he/she lives
Can talk about their immediate family members
Can express likes and dislikes in relation to familiar topics in a basic way
Can say what the weather is like
4.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can sing an age-appropriate, level-appropriate song or recite a rhyme from memory
Can say simple tongue-twisters and other types of playful language
Can take part in age-appropriate, level-appropriate games that use formulaic expressions or rhymes
4.source_ref: Spoken production – Playing with spoken language (new)
4.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

4.title_en: Simple conversation: greetings, introductions, asking for things
4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can introduce people and use basic greetings and leave-taking expressions
Can ask how people are and react to personal news
Can ask people for things and give people things
Can ask for food and drink using basic expressions
4.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

4.title_he: כתיבת משפטים פשוטים ואיות מילים יצרניות
4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can write simple isolated phrases and sentences using level-appropriate language (vocabulary and grammar) and spelling that approximates accurate conventions based on a developmental continuum
Can describe certain everyday objects (e.g., the color of a car, whether it is big or small)
Can copy familiar words and common, frequent short phrases (e.g., simple signs, instructions, names of everyday objects and shops)
4.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can write his/her name, address, age, date of birth, nationality, numbers etc. where required (e.g., on a registration form)
Can ask for or pass on personal details in written form
4.source_ref: Written interaction – Notes, messages and forms
4.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

4.title_he: משפטים עם to be, there is/are ושאלות
4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
grammar: Declarative clauses with 'to be' + not/n't to describe a state (Amir is tall. They aren't tall.)
Declarative clauses with lexical verbs to describe a state (I like English. I don't like sport.)
Yes/no questions with auxiliary 'do' (Does Anna play sports? Yes, she does.)
Wh-questions with 'to be' and lexical verbs (Where is the party? When does the lesson begin?)
'There is/There are' to introduce the subject
Imperatives for instructions; 'Let's' + verb for suggestions
4.source_ref: Grade 4 column: CLAUSES; VERBS: Imperative, Present/Linking 'TO BE', There is/There are

4.title_he: זמנים: Present simple, Present continuous, Past simple (פעלים סדירים), can
4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
grammar: Present simple affirmative and negative for habits (Ofer usually watches TV. Lucie doesn't watch TV.)
Present simple yes/no questions
Present continuous affirmative 'be + verb-ing' (Gal is walking her dog.)
Past simple affirmative with regular verbs (I played football with Tom.)
'Can' / 'can't' for ability; 'Can …?' questions for ability and requests
4.source_ref: Grade 4 column: VERBS: Present simple, Present continuous, Past simple lexical verbs; MODALITY

4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
grammar: Plural -s on common countable nouns
Subject pronouns I/you/he/she/it/we/they; object pronouns me/him/her/us/them after verbs; 'it' as object
Articles a/an for a non-specific noun; the vs a/an for known/new information
Possessive determiners (your, his, their) and 's (Reuben's shop)
Coordinating 'and'/'or'/'but' joining words and phrases; 'because' after a main clause
Single-word prepositions of time and place (on Monday, at 4:00)
4.source_ref: Grade 4 column: NOUNS; DETERMINERS; PREPOSITIONS; CLAUSES: Coordinated/Subordinated

4.title_he: אוצר מילים – Band I Core I
4.title_en: Lexical Band I Core I (Grade 4 – mid-Grade 5)
4.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can draw on his/her receptive and productive knowledge of vocabulary (Lexical Band I) when relating to particular concrete situations
Can spell the lexical entries in Lexical Band I marked as productive with reasonable accuracy
4.source_ref: BAND I CORE I (547 entries); S1 Table 2

5.title_en: Picking out information from recordings and announcements
5.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can pick out concrete information (e.g., places and times) from short audio recordings on familiar everyday topics, provided they are delivered slowly and clearly
Can identify the day, date and time (e.g., 8:00, this afternoon) in short, simple dialogues
Can understand information (e.g., figures, prices and times) spoken slowly and clearly in a public announcement (e.g., at a railway station or in a shop)
Can understand when someone tells him/her where something is, provided the object is in the immediate environment
5.source_ref: Spoken reception – Listening to announcements / audio media
5.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

5.title_he: קריאה להתמצאות: מודעות, מערכת שעות, הודעות
5.title_en: Reading for orientation and short messages
5.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can understand short, simple messages in notes, social media or email (e.g., proposing what to do, when and where to meet)
Can find and understand simple, important information in advertisements, programs for special events, leaflets and brochures
Can understand the information in a simple school timetable giving days and times of classes
Can follow short, simple written directions (e.g., to go from X to Y)
5.source_ref: Written reception – Reading correspondence / for orientation
5.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

5.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can follow basic instructions for making something (e.g., a mask, a clock), if supported by pictures/illustrations
Can understand short, simple descriptions of familiar places written in level-appropriate language (vocabulary and grammar)
5.source_ref: Written reception – Reading instructions; Reading as a leisure activity
5.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

5.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can describe someone's physical appearance in a basic way
Can say what someone's job is, using familiar common job names
Can describe the position of objects or people using pictures or gestures
Can answer a series of simple questions about family and friends, using basic phrases
5.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

5.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can ask and answer questions about themselves and other people, where they live, people they know, things they have
Can exchange likes and dislikes for sports, foods, etc. when addressed clearly, slowly and directly
Can ask for the price of basic products/services
Can act on short, basic instructions that involve times, locations, numbers, etc.
5.source_ref: Spoken interaction – Information exchange; Obtaining goods and services
5.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

5.title_he: כתיבה יצירתית: על עצמי ועל דמויות
5.title_en: Creative writing about people and places
5.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can write about themselves and fictitious people, where they live and what they do
Can link words or groups of words with basic linear connectors (e.g., 'and', 'then')
Shows evolving control of periods, commas, question marks, apostrophes and capital letters
5.source_ref: Written production – Creative writing; Coherence; Orthographic control
5.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

5.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can write messages and online postings as a series of very short sentences about hobbies and likes/dislikes
Can leave a simple informative message giving, for example, where he/she has gone, what time he/she will be back
Can post short reactions to simple online postings using formulaic expressions and combinations of simple words
5.source_ref: Written interaction – Correspondence; Notes; Online interaction
5.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

5.title_he: עבר: was/were, פעלים סדירים ולא סדירים, שלילה ושאלות
5.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
grammar: Past 'to be' (was/were), affirmative and negative, and yes/no + wh-questions about a past state
Past simple of irregular verbs (they found a dog … Dana took the dog home)
Past simple negative with didn't (Tom didn't talk during our game)
'Did …?' yes/no questions and wh-questions with 'did' (When did you go to bed last night?)
5.source_ref: Grade 5 column: VERBS: Past/Linking, Past simple linking verbs questions, Past simple lexical verbs

5.title_he: עתיד והווה: will, be going to, present continuous בשלילה ושאלות
5.title_en: Future forms and more present tenses in Grade 5
5.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
grammar: 'Will + verb' and 'won't + verb' for plans and intentions; 'Will you …?' yes/no questions
'Be going to + verb' affirmative; yes/no and wh-questions with 'going to'
Present continuous negative and questions; temporary situations
Present simple wh-questions with 'do' (What do you eat for breakfast?); mental process verbs think/hope/know
Frequency adverbs always/sometimes with present simple
5.source_ref: Grade 5 column: VERBS: Future 'WILL', 'BE GOING TO', Present continuous, Present simple questions/mental process; ADVERBS: Frequency

5.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
grammar: Comparative adjectives: -er (bigger), -y → -ier (easier, funnier), irregular (better, further)
Quantifying determiners some/any with plural and uncountable nouns
'The + adjective' in a noun phrase (opposite the tall building)
Two main clauses joined with and/but/or (Mika likes most vegetables, but she doesn't like avocados.)
Object pronouns after prepositions (important to them); prepositional phrases of time and place (under the bed)
5.source_ref: Grade 5 column: ADJECTIVES: Comparative; DETERMINERS: Quantity; CLAUSES: Coordinated; NOUNS: Pronouns; PREPOSITIONS

5.title_he: אוצר מילים – סיום Core I ומעבר ל-Core II
5.title_en: Lexical Band I Core I → Core II (Core II starts mid-Grade 5)

skills: Can draw on his/her receptive and productive knowledge of vocabulary (Lexical Band I) when relating to particular concrete situations
5.source_ref: BAND I CORE I and BAND I CORE II; S1 Table 2 (Core I: Grade 4 – mid-Grade 5; Core II: mid-Grade 5 – end Grade 6)

6.title_he: הבנת הוראה עם תנאי והבנת שיחה בין דוברים
6.title_en: Conditional instructions and conversations between speakers
6.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can understand a simple instruction containing a qualifying condition (e.g., 'If your birthday is in March, stand here.')
Can understand words and short sentences when listening to a simple conversation (e.g., between a customer and a waiter in a cafe), when people talk slowly and clearly
Can understand sentence types (e.g., questions) through word order rather than intonation alone
Can seek repetition and clarification to understand spoken language, and may ask other speakers for meanings of words
6.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

6.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can recognize familiar words and phrases and identify the topics in headline news summaries and many of the products in advertisements, by exploiting visual information and activating general background knowledge
6.source_ref: Spoken reception – Watching TV, film and video
6.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

6.title_he: קריאת טקסטים מידעיים: רעיון עיקרי מול פרטים
6.title_en: Reading for information: main ideas vs. unimportant details
6.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can understand stories and short texts on a range of familiar topics (e.g., sports, music or travel) written in level-appropriate language and supported by illustrations, rereading as required
Can form an idea of the content of simple informational material and short simple descriptions, especially if there is visual support
Can differentiate between main ideas and unimportant information in factual texts (new)
6.source_ref: Written reception – Overall; Reading for information and argument
6.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

6.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can describe simple aspects of his/her everyday life in a series of simple sentences, especially if he/she can prepare in advance
Can give a simple description of an object or picture while showing it to others, especially when he/she can prepare in advance
Can read a very short, rehearsed statement (e.g., to introduce the participants in a role play)
Can re-tell parts of a story (with or without pictures) read by the teacher or from previous knowledge
Can draw simple conclusions about people in pictures (e.g., 'he's happy')
6.source_ref: Spoken production – Sustained monologue; Addressing audiences; Playing with spoken language
6.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

6.title_he: שיחה על נושא צפוי, ריאיון ושיתוף פעולה
6.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can take part in a simple conversation of a basic factual nature on a predictable topic (e.g., his/her home country, family, school)
Can reply in an interview to simple direct questions about personal details
Can state in simple language the nature of a problem to a health professional and answer simple questions such as 'Does that hurt?'
Can express an idea in simple language and ask what others think; can indicate that he/she understands and ask whether others understand
6.source_ref: Spoken interaction – Conversation; Interviewing; Mediation – Collaboration
6.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

6.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can write simple isolated phrases and sentences using level-appropriate language and spelling that approximates accurate conventions
Can use simple words, phrases and sentences to say how a work made him/her feel
Can list names, numbers, prices and very simple information of immediate interest
Can spell the lexical entries in Lexical Band I marked as productive with reasonable accuracy
6.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

6.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
skills: Can fill out sections of a very simple online purchase or application, providing basic personal information (e.g., name, e-mail address or telephone number)
Can write messages and online postings as a series of very short sentences about hobbies and likes/dislikes
6.inferred_note: The A1 can-do statements are published once for grades 4–6; placing this subset in this grade is inferred (simpler statements earlier, more demanding later).

6.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
grammar: Comparative with 'than' to compare two nouns (England is bigger than Ireland.)
'More' + longer adjectives (more comfortable than)
Superlative 'the + -est + noun' (the tallest building in Israel)
Superlative 'the most + adjective + noun' (the most beautiful bird)
Manner adverbs (plays happily, smiles sweetly)
6.source_ref: Grade 6 column: ADJECTIVES: Comparative/Superlative; ADVERBS: Manner

6.title_en: General truths and full future forms
6.band: A1 (Basic User I) / Lexical Band I, Grammar Band I
grammar: Present simple for general truths, affirmative and negative (Koala bears live only in Australia. They don't drink water.)
Wh-questions with 'will' (When will you visit me again?)
Negative 'be not going to + verb' (We aren't going to cook dinner tonight.)
Consolidation of all Band I tenses: present simple/continuous, past simple (regular/irregular), will, be going to
6.source_ref: Grade 6 column: VERBS: Present simple, Future 'WILL' questions, 'BE GOING TO'

6.title_he: אוצר מילים – Band I Core II (כל Band I יצרני עד סוף ו')

Can draw on his/her receptive and productive knowledge of vocabulary (Lexical Band I) when relating to particular concrete situations
6.source_ref: BAND I CORE II (597 entries); S1 p.21
